The '''Teevan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teevan (planet)|Teevan]].
